status_enum.yellow: 受控试点 controlled pilot (gates: virtual_evaluation -> controlled_site -> limited_real_street)
status_enum.red: 折返 switchback: revert to last stable state with public explanation
status_enum.green_candidate: 预备态(非运行状态):协议字段齐备、待核准;低风险场景核准后可直接转绿,涉试点门槛的须先入黄

takeover_max_minutes.number: 真人接管时限设计目标值(分钟),设计目标非政府承诺
takeover_max_minutes.null: 空值须由同卡 takeover_status 字段消歧

takeover_status.not_applicable: 无自主运行闭环或非实时服务,接管概念不适用
takeover_status.designed: 已设计人工接管路径,未实测

anchor.anchor_type=geojson_ref: anchor_ref 给出 file#feature_id,可对包内几何做空间校验

field_semantics.heritage_constraint: 若场景位于或邻近文保单位保护范围/建控地带,须登记该约束(见 geometry/heritage_protection.geojson)

belt_wide_defaults.non_smart_fallback: 15-minute-walk ordinary-equivalent service path; non-smartphone and accessible paths designed in parallel
belt_wide_defaults.switchback_trigger: one safety-grade event requiring human takeover, OR 90-day complaint/takeover-failure rate above threshold (threshold set after phase-1 measurement, not pre-filled)
belt_wide_defaults.recovery_rule: back to green only after two consecutive qualifying review cycles plus one observation period; switchback decision != validity judgment
belt_wide_defaults.ledger: Switchback Ledger entries published at quarterly Switchback Days (near-miss / switchback / decommission tiers, with write-back discipline and auto-review queue)
belt_wide_defaults.disclaimer_zh: 全部时限为设计目标值,非政府承诺;正式时限以运营协议为准。所有场景为概念建议,不表述为已批准运营。文保相关场景须遵守文物保护范围与建控地带管控,当前几何为 provisional 推定,以官方图纸为准。
belt_wide_defaults.disclaimer_en: All time limits are design targets, not government commitments; formal limits per operating agreements. All scenarios are conceptual suggestions. Heritage-adjacent scenarios must comply with protection-zone controls; current geometry is provisional.

roles_model.accountable_operator: single named operator per pilot (to be named at pilot approval; null until then)

cards.anchor: AI原点社区 近校成果转化街
cards.fallback: 线下人工登记与人工路演管理;无智能体时按传统会展流程运行
cards.data_boundary: 不采集个人画像;访客数据仅聚合统计
cards.human_review: 园区运营方人工复核发布内容;申诉1/7工作日

cards.anchor: 众智园 AI自主创新加速区
cards.fallback: 沙盒测试改为人工审核队列,不自动放行
cards.data_boundary: 红队测试数据不公开细节,只公开聚合结论
cards.human_review: 安全官可现场暂停;评测结果独立复核

cards.anchor: 总体设计范围节点(产业中试/算力用地)
cards.fallback: 非实时服务,无接管概念;运维走既有市政管线流程
cards.data_boundary: 算力使用匿名化;不存个人数据

cards.fallback: 15分钟步行圈普通等价路径;非智能手机与无障碍路径并行设计
cards.data_boundary: 低侵入传感;无面部识别;轨迹匿名聚合
cards.human_review: 公园管理方监督;断点报告公开

cards.fallback: 非实时服务;展示/洽谈按传统会展流程
cards.data_boundary: 企业展示内容清权;访客不采集画像
cards.next_gate_needs: 文保协调(觉生寺邻近,见 heritage_protection.geojson#HER-002)
cards.heritage_constraint: 设计区西界紧邻觉生寺(第四批国保,保护范围距边界约3m);本卡须遵守保护范围/建控地带管控,保护范围内不新增建构筑物

cards.data_boundary: 雨洪监测数据仅聚合;无个人数据

cards.anchor: AI原点社区 近校创新生态圈
cards.fallback: 人工投融资对接与法务流程
cards.data_boundary: 项目信息脱敏;不导出个人画像
cards.human_review: 高校成果转化办+园区联合复核

cards.fallback: 数据流通展示走人工合规审查
cards.data_boundary: 以合规、授权、可审计为前提;不展示未授权数据
cards.heritage_constraint: 同 ER-05:觉生寺文保邻近约束

cards.anchor: 社区与商业交汇处(居住/商业混合)
cards.fallback: 传统社区服务窗口并行;非智能手机路径
cards.data_boundary: 医疗/教育/法律AI场景不采集健康隐私;仅聚合
cards.human_review: 街道/社区复核;申诉1/7工作日
cards.next_gate_needs: controlled-site trial report + 社区同意

cards.name_en: Slow-mobility Gap Detection (ops form of ER-04)
cards.data_boundary: 低侵入传感;无个人画像

cards.fallback: 人工安保巡检;不自动决策
cards.data_boundary: 数据仅做聚合,不输出个人画像
cards.human_review: 安全官可现场暂停;事件报告公开

ledger_tiers.near_miss: no harm caused but credible harm path revealed; pre-harm signals enter the ledger
ledger_tiers.decommission: permanently retired assets incl. dismantling method and data destruction

ledger_disciplines.write_back: every review-born design change must be written back into its scenario card
ledger_disciplines.auto_review_queue: model update / source withdrawal / authorization expiry -> dependent scenarios auto-enqueue for review; high-risk services degraded to human operation until cleared

evidence_status_enum.known: recomputable in EPSG:4548 (对应 EBIP 证据分级 formal/provisional 可复算)
evidence_status_enum.design_target: design target, not a government commitment

migration: 本协议为对 open-city-ai/haidian Issue #1119 折返协议 v1.0 的定制适配,保留五组件命名(三色状态/时限/90天复审/量化触发/三级留痕)以便横向比较;字段结构 0.2.0 与模板兼容
